name: Hau nuong moi
summary: Hàu nướng mọi is rock oysters from Đầm Lập An, grilled the way the cooks here favor. The rock oyster is firm and strongly fragrant.
origin: Lang Co, on Đầm Lập An. Nhân Dân, 5 July 2024. The same article says the lagoon farms hàu đá only.
texture: The rock oyster is firm and strongly fragrant, and the cooks favor it for this grill, for cheese, or for porridge.
seoTitle: Hau nuong moi in Lang Co — rock oysters
seoDescription: Hàu nướng mọi is rock oysters grilled on Đầm Lập An, firm and strongly fragrant.
